BASELINE CONTAMINATION (Eval 3): Baseline agents can discover skill files in the repo at .claude/skills/desloppify/. Eval 3 baseline copied the hook template directly, producing identical results to with-skill.
STRONGEST DIFFERENTIATION (Eval 1): With-skill adapted by performing desloppify-style manual analysis and reporting a score. Baseline gave up entirely (0% vs 33%).
METHODOLOGY SIGNAL (Eval 2): With-skill followed desloppify's dimension framework; baseline used generic analysis. This is the clearest skill value signal despite sandbox limitations.
With-skill agents used ~24% more tokens and ~46% more time on average, reflecting more thorough analysis and multiple install retry attempts.
